## Flexible signatures

Positional, keyword, `*args`, and `**kwargs`. Keyword-only args come after `*`; positional-only before `/`.

## Default gotcha

Never use a mutable default (`def f(x=[])`) — it is created once and shared. Use `None` and create inside.

## Docstrings

The first string in a function is its docstring, surfaced by `help()` and tools.
